data.title: Bitcoin eyes $84,000 as whale withdrawals surge and institutional activity grows
data.description: Investing.com -- Bitcoin traded under $81,000 as large-holder withdrawals and institutional wallet activity raised hopes of a recovery towards $84,000, despite continued uncertainty across cryptocurrency markets.
